authority_invariant: Continuity systems preserve already-authorized institutional state and evidence. They never manufacture authority, rights, provider deployment, certification, or a production claim.

systems.purpose: Govern append-only serialization, stable identity, anti-overwrite/delete controls, tombstones, lineage, integrity snapshots, replay, and continuity receipts.
systems.human_surface: Serialized artifact lineage, tombstones, integrity, replay, recovery, and continuity status
systems.authority_boundary: PentaSerialized may preserve and restore already-authorized state, but cannot manufacture authority, rights, provider deployment, certification, or erase institutional history.

five_stage.discover: Resolve the already-authorized material state, stable identity, expected lineage, and current continuity position.
five_stage.govern: Enforce anti-overwrite, anti-delete, tombstone, authority, integrity, and retention policy.
five_stage.execute: Serialize or restore through the bounded repository-native runtime only after the applicable independent gate.
five_stage.verify: Replay and verify the hash chain, identity, tombstones, snapshots, and continuity receipt.
five_stage.preserve: Retain append-only lineage, recovery evidence, and the independently governed provider-runtime HOLD state.

systems.purpose: Define SHA-256 evidence-backed snapshots, manifests, and restore baselines for already-authorized institutional state.
systems.human_surface: Snapshot manifests, integrity state, restore baselines, and continuity evidence
systems.authority_boundary: PentaSnapshot may preserve a content-addressed recovery baseline but cannot authorize a restore, erase lineage, certify a provider, or manufacture production state.

five_stage.discover: Resolve the authorized source state and expected content-addressed baseline.
five_stage.govern: Bind scope, retention, integrity, restore authority, and anti-erasure controls.
five_stage.execute: Produce a snapshot only through an independently authorized continuity operation.
five_stage.verify: Validate manifest closure, content hashes, lineage, and restore suitability.
five_stage.preserve: Retain the immutable snapshot manifest and continuity evidence without implying deployment.

systems.purpose: Govern canonical component, content, policy, schema, compatibility, effective-state, and supersession lineage.
systems.human_surface: Version identity, compatibility line, lifecycle, effective state, and supersession history
systems.authority_boundary: PentaVersion records governed lineage but version changes alone cannot certify a component, waive a HOLD, publish a provider release, or authorize use.

five_stage.discover: Resolve the canonical subject, current version, scheme, lifecycle, and prior lineage.
five_stage.govern: Apply compatibility, effective-state, supersession, and non-replacement policy.
five_stage.execute: Record an authorized version transition without changing provider or certification state.
five_stage.verify: Validate scheme, predecessor, compatibility, evidence, and effective-state coherence.
five_stage.preserve: Retain append-only version and supersession lineage with every independent HOLD intact.
